$comment: Reference games for the frame gate (bun run perf gate), and the fallback budget for a game without its own perf-budget.json. Every game is judged on one 16.7 ms p95 frame on the RTX 3070 at 1600x900; draws are reported, not gated.

harbor-heat.baseline: 2026-10-23 bun run perf harbor-heat --seconds 6, whole-frame p95 as the gate compares it, GeForce RTX 3070 D3D11, 1600x900 full, engine 02162d4a at pinned Games dac3865e. drawsFrame is that run's whole-frame draw ceiling, printed beside each gate run as a reference, not gated; every game is judged on the shared 16.7 ms p95 frame.
